description: This file defines the 'Affiliate' controller class within the OpenCart framework. It manages the display and saving of affiliate account information, including rendering the affiliate form page, handling form validation, and updating affiliate data.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Controller class for managing affiliate account view and form submission logic in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the affiliate account page, loading necessary data, and rendering the template.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the submission of the affiliate form, validates inputs, updates or creates affiliate data, and returns JSON response.
